HDDS-6148.title: Validate ContainerBalancerConfiguration before start ContainerBalancer
HDDS-6148.description:
In HDDS-6070, we did some refactoring on ContainerBalancerConfiguration, and we added a method called validateConfiguration to check the configurations. 

Currently the method returns "void", but it's more reasonable to return a boolean to indicate the validate result of the configurations.

This ticket is to change the return parameter from "void" to boolean to check the parameters before doing container balancer work.

commits.message: HDDS-6148. Validate ContainerBalancerConfiguration before start ContainerBalancer
commits.author: symious

commits.message: HDDS-6148. Set balancerRunning after validate configuration succeeds
commits.author: symious

HDDS-6170.title: Add metrics to replication manager to track container health states
HDDS-6170.description:
ReplicationManager processes all containers in the system periodically, but it does not log or publish any metrics around the health of the containers. Eg how many are under or over replicated, unhealthy, stuck in quasi-closed etc.

We should count up the number in each state and report it via the metrics to give better insight about the state of the cluster.

commits.message: Added ReplicationManagerReport and integrated with ReplicationManager
commits.author: S O'Donnell

commits.message: Make the report incrementAndSample thread safe
commits.author: S O'Donnell

HDDS-6147.title: Add ability in OM to get limited delta updates
HDDS-6147.description:
In HDDS-1391, the API to get delta updates from OM is added.

In a busy cluster, the delta updates may be very large that could affect the OM's performance while the API is being invoked. This issue happens when Recon is trying to retrieve large delta updates from OM.

This ticket is to add a new API to limit the update counts clients can retrieve each time.

commits.message: HDDS-6147. Add ability in OM to get limited delta updates
commits.author: symious

HDDS-6219.title: Switch to RATIS ReplicationType from STAND_ALONE in our tests
HDDS-6219.description:
There are quite a good amount of integration tests that are still using the STAND_ALONE replication type to write data to the MiniCluster they use.
The goal is to replace the writes and use RATIS ReplicationType in all the tests we have for writes.

commits.message: HDDS-6219. Switch to RATIS ReplicationType from STAND_ALONE in our tests.
commits.author: fapifta
